description: The bar chart illustrates sample counts for four essay genres, with two conditions shown for each genre (“Open” and “Cons.”) to represent two sets of counts. The horizontal axis contains the genre categories in left-to-right order: Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, while the vertical axis is labeled “Sample Count” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 up to about 130 with regularly spaced tick marks at 20-unit intervals. For each genre, two adjacent bars are displayed: an “Open” bar in blue-gray and a “Cons.” bar in muted mauve, with numeric value labels above each bar. Argumentative shows Open = 79 and Cons. = 122; Narrative shows Open = 80 and Cons. = 87; Descriptive shows Open = 68 and Cons. = 100; Expository shows Open = 62 and Cons. = 130. The bars are grouped by genre (side-by-side within each category), a legend at the top identifies the two colors, and there is no visual indication that the categories are sorted by value or otherwise emphasized beyond the value annotations.
